flag.method: Continuous analytic bound: stick/cloth localY>=0 and localX>=-.02. For theta0..pi/2, worldX=.24+x*cos(theta)+y*sin(theta)>=.22. All flag points lie Y>=.93 and Z.08..3; clip entire shell triangles to that region and bound their maxX.

letter.method: Original emergence is intentional: letter halfwidth.17 starts atX.35 so enters shell envelope toX.18; then follows original position/rotation formulas. Do not claim zero overlaps during emergence. Later motion is clear of shell by conservative bounding sphere.
